entry_trigger.phrase: Initiate pipeline: route request to seo-keyword-researcher.

auto_flow_rules.action: Research SEO keywords for a topic and generate an article brief with primary keywords, secondary keywords, competition analysis, article structure, and SEO recommendations.
auto_flow_rules.auto_trigger: Continue from seo-keyword-researcher to Blog Writer as defined by the retained case-study path.

auto_flow_rules.action: Turn the article brief into a complete blog draft using the requested style and writing command.
auto_flow_rules.auto_trigger: Continue from Blog Writer to wechat-content-creator as defined by the retained case-study path.

auto_flow_rules.action: Transform the blog draft into a WeChat-ready article package with platform-specific structure and formatting.
auto_flow_rules.auto_trigger: Return the resulting article package to seo-keyword-researcher as the next queued content item in the retained case-study path.

auto_flow_description: This case-study pipeline contains three retained stages. After the entry instruction "Initiate pipeline: route request to seo-keyword-researcher.", the workflow proceeds through seo-keyword-researcher -> Blog Writer -> wechat-content-creator and then returns the resulting article package to the starting stage as defined by the retained evaluation path.
